title: Error provenance timeline and tracehook onramp for inference latency classification
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Problem: We lack a single, queryable timeline that shows the provenance of an inference request across transport (HTTP/gRPC), runtime (scheduler/batcher), and model execution (rejection/oom/response codes). Current dashboards show siloed signals (latency histograms, RPC error rates, and model rejection counts) but do not connect causality.

Goal: Build an "error provenance timeline" and a low-friction tracehook onramp that normalizes events across layers and maps them to a concise failure taxonomy (timeout, overload, model-error, model-reject, rpc-4xx/5xx, auth, network). Deliverables:
- Telemetry schema (single event and span attributes) to annotate origin: {transport_stage, runtime_stage, model_stage, error_code, model_signal, kv_cache_hit, queue_time_ms}.
- A tracehook shim for customer-facing endpoints that attaches a short provenance context when sampling or forwarding traces.
- Ingest pipeline changes (metrics/logs) to produce an aggregated error_provenance stream for dashboards and OLAP.
- Grafana dashboard panels: Error Origin Swimlane, RPC->Model Cascade Timeline, Overload Signature Heatmap, and Failure Breadcrumbs (top correlated tags).
- Mapping document that translates HTTP/gRPC codes + runtime signals to the canonical taxonomy and a fallback heuristic for ambiguous cases.

Acceptance criteria:
1) New event schema documented in Confluence and implemented by the runtime (PR linked).
2) Tracehook available behind a feature flag; sample rate defaults 1% and adjustable per-customer.
3) At least four dashboard panels live in the production Grafana folder with filters for model, route, and region.
4) Alerting rule that triggers when model-rejects or transport-5xx rise above baseline and Owner runbook links to remediation steps.
5) Regression test in CI that validates telemetry keys are present for synthetic traces.

Trade-offs:
- We will start with a conservative schema to avoid excessive cardinality; richer fields can be added after observing tag explosion.
- Initial tracehook will only attach a compact provenance token instead of full payloads to reduce PII risk.

Implementation plan (high level):
1) Finalize schema and mapping doc (2 days).
2) Runtime instrumentation: emit provenance attributes at RPC boundary, scheduler enqueue/dequeue, batch start/end, model start/end (4 days).
3) Tracehook shim and feature flag (2 days).
4) Metrics/log pipeline transform: new Kafka topic + OLAP mapping (3 days).
5) Dashboard + alerts + runbook (3 days).
6) QA, canary, and rollout (4 days).

Notes: This ticket focuses on the platform side scaffolding. Follow-up tickets will cover customer-facing UI for drilled-in evidence links and per-tenant sampling policies.
